message:
[font_size=16][b]Welcome to the Oscillator's Court[/b][/font_size]

The pendulum is still. Five beads wait on the board.
I placed Fount nearest the centre. I want to see whether making things can still be gentle.
The orbit leans toward Restoration. The court reads a Foundry cooling, its fires banked for the season.
The Tapestry remembers every fire it was asked to keep.
Then who keeps the fire when nobody asks?
